definitions.explanation: A kitchen, especially a professional or commercial one in a restaurant, hotel, or institution. More formal and technical than 台所.

examples.japanese: {厨房|ちゅうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{厨房|ちゅうぼう}⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{厨房|ちゅうぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{衛生|えいせい}{管理|かんり}→衛生管理：17986_eiseikanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}している→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant's kitchen has thorough hygiene management.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厨房|ちゅうぼう}⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧ (kitchen equipment)
- {厨房|ちゅうぼう}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧ (kitchen facilities)
- {厨房|ちゅうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (stand in the kitchen, work as a cook)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧ is the everyday word for a home kitchen. {厨房|ちゅうぼう} implies a larger, professional kitchen — the kind found in restaurants, hotels, and institutional cafeterias. When talking about a home kitchen, use ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧ or ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧. {厨房|ちゅうぼう} for a home kitchen would sound overly formal or humorous.
